'''A'Lenba starport''' was located in the [[o'beki]] of [[A'Lenba]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. Smaller than the [[Graith starport|main starport]] located at [[Graith]], A'Lenba starport was similarly laid out with a large military area and smaller civilian and commercial zone.

Security for the military zone is provided by three to four [[K7 "Black Dagger" Security Droid]]s. Two four-ship [[Flight group/Legends|flight groups]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] were stationed at the starport.
